results.title: Engage Diomaye to curb Senegalese incursions – Darboe
results.description: By Omar Bah UDP leader Ousainu Darboe has advised President Adama Barrow to urgently engage Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye to halt an escalating border dispute that threatens to displace farmers.
